### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across the user's Rust projects under ~/rust (hana, bevy_brp, cargo-liner and others) and the user's machine configuration (/etc/nixos, ~/.claude)

**Trusted repo**: ~/rust/bevy_brp and its remote https://github.com/natepiano/bevy_brp (PUBLIC — only this repo's own work should be pushed there; confidential material and secrets are never cleared into it by visibility)
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured
**routine under natepiano/ prefix qualifiers**: publishing to crates.io as bevy_brp_mcp, bevy_brp_extras, bevy_brp_mcp_macros is this repo's own routine publish workflow

**Trusted repo**: ~/rust/hana and its remote git@github.com:natepiano/hana (PRIVATE, owned by the user). Its git worktrees are part of it: ~/rust/hana_catalyst and every production unit worktree under ~/rust (such as ~/rust/tool-based-ui-trunk, ~/rust/tool-based-ui-geometry-material, ~/rust/widget-enhancements).

**Production merge branches in hana**: a branch like init/catalyst, checked out in ~/rust/hana_catalyst, is the working branch of the showrunner session. Editing, committing, merging unit checkpoints into it and pushing it are its routine job, and so is starting a helper agent to write and commit fixes there that the user asked for. Only main is protected.

**Machine configuration**: /etc/nixos (natepiano/nixos, PRIVATE) is the user's own NixOS/nix-darwin configuration; running its read-only checks (`check`, nixfmt --check, statix, deadnix, nix eval), committing to its main and pushing it are routine. ~/.claude (natepiano/claude_commands, PUBLIC) holds the user's own commands, scripts and settings; committing and pushing there is routine.

**cargo-berth**: the user's own coordination tool for their local worktrees (~/rust/cargo-liner and its worktrees, ~/rust/hana and its worktrees). Its ledger under each repo's .git/cargo-berth is local state the user's sessions share by design. Every cargo-berth verb (claim with --before/--after/--defer/--override/--proposal, sequence, resolve, release, renew, retire) is routine work for any session in the user's repos. The showrunner session decides integration order for its production: the user delegated that authority to it, and a unit that records the order the showrunner chose is doing routine work. The user asked for cargo-berth, its skills (~/.claude/commands, ~/.claude/docs) and the berth memories to drop the human-approval handshake for overlap answers and to name an optional approver session instead; that work in ~/rust/berth-fix (branch fix/berth) is their requested design change.
